method.primary: Three independent fresh launches per runtime/mode, all three variants in cyclic load order; round order alternates, 600ms warmup/module, 9 rounds of at least 160ms/module. Node --expose-gc and GC before each batch; Bun no explicit GC. All CPU work serial. Primary summaries use median of process medians and ratio-of-median reductions; per-process paired reductions are separately archived. No outliers removed.
method.confirmation: Cold standard7 and warm attrs11 repeated in six matched fresh-process triples per runtime (each process imports ONE variant); all six variant-order permutations used. Confirmation percent summaries use medians of six within-triple ratios, unlike primary table. These are independent launch observations, not nine-round pseudoreplicates; ranges are descriptive, not confidence intervals.
method.cacheControl: Cold/query-repetition modes create new documents on each workload call; verification uses separate objects, never timed cold documents. Warm modes reuse independently created docs and execute a complete query/read workload before timing. Fresh reads recreate docs and enumerate elements outside every timed read pass. Pairs-prewarmed mode gets class once on every element before queries, without reading attributes.
method.retainedMemory: Five independent fresh Node processes per variant/mode. Input strings, imports and a tiny mutable-API dispatch probe already alive before baseline; two GC calls before/after. Deltas heapUsed+external with all docs and matching result arrays retained. All final 7/11 selector results retained (not only last selector). Hydrated mode also reads attributes on every element, retaining resulting records in docs. Not peak allocation/RSS.
method.repetition: Each cumulative operation parses all 12 pages once, then repeats the entire 7- or 11-selector batch N times on the same documents. Parse remains in timer; only final batch results remain in sink. N counts batches, not selectors.
method.apiDispatch: All timings import only src/mutable/index.ts bundles; dispatch probe asserts parsed elements expose setAttr. No substring API selection.
